title: Ave Maria...benedicta tu (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Ave Maria...benedicta tu. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Petrucci, Motetti C (1504) - Josquin.
